dataset_title: Green biomass protein precipitation outcomes: ryegrass and red clover reference observations
source_title: Enhancing Protein Recovery in Green Biorefineries by Lignosulfonate-Assisted Precipitation
geography: Experimental field near Store Heddinge, Zealand, Denmark
data_basis: Crude protein concentration is percent of concentrate dry matter. Nitrogen recovery is total N recovered in fiber fraction plus protein concentrate divided by juice N; direct heat rows marked without prior clearing instead use uncleared juice. Standard deviations for crude protein are percentage points, n=3.
processing_and_conversions: Values transcribed as reported; no numeric conversions or inferred values. Lignosulfonate load is recorded in source-reported N-equivalents.
applicability: Reference-only experimental evidence; ryegrass and red clover juice are not measured GreenHub roadside-grass streams.
limitations: Total-N precipitation/recovery is not equivalent to isolated true-protein recovery.
Overall recovery includes nitrogen in the clearing fiber fraction and protein concentrate for clarified routes.
Feed was harvested near Store Heddinge, frozen within 3 h, stored at -20 C and later thawed; freeze-thaw may affect protein precipitation.
The experiment used twin-screw pressing, 1:1 water re-pressing of pulp and mild centrifuge clearing, unlike the default GreenHub route.
No outlet mass flows or separator capture balance are supplied by this table; it cannot parameterize a closed unit balance.
